description: This file contains the PHP class 'ShippingMethod' which is part of the OpenCart API under the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Controller.Api.Sale. It defines API endpoints for retrieving and saving shipping methods associated with sales, including handling requests and responses in JSON format.

classes.name: ShippingMethod
classes.description: API controller class managing shipping method retrieval and updates for sale transactions in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve available shipping methods, verifying shipping address existence, and responding with JSON data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save selected shipping methods, validating input, and updating the session data accordingly.
